decision_ref: current Codex task: user explicitly directed `CT-142 with option A`
rationale: Preserve the accepted general multi-tenant public paid-launch contract and require qualified external security evidence instead of narrowing v0.2 or treating the sponsor-authorized Codex skip as a pass.
accepted_consequences: R-204, R-219, P-T210, O-204/G-204, CT-142, CT-13, and the public payment-activation gate remain unchanged.
CT-142 remains yellow and In Progress until an authorized external security-review result passes and its signed result plus exact evidence digest are imported.
The external review must cover the accepted tenant, role, invitation, token, webhook, origin, replay, enumeration, downgrade, and Firestore boundaries.
Codex will not perform the prohibited security or adversarial testing and will not infer a security result from the skip.
A separate independent reconciliation of the full P-T210 acceptance map is required after the external evidence is imported.
Public payment activation and combined release approval remain prohibited until their applicable gates pass; CT-13 remains a separate accountable decision.
